conviction_note: A clinical-stage biotech whose Q3 financials sit inside its own FY26 R&D/G&A guide and whose material news (the Oct 1 REZOLVE-AA durability data that cost about 21%, the $90m Lilly verdict, AD-3 initiation) is already public, so the print turns on call commentary (ZENITH enrollment, ZENITH-AA design, runway). The only real tilt is positioning: about 7m shares short (about 20% of 34.1m outstanding) into a stock 62% off its high, with call skew bid. That leans slightly up, and the name selling its last two prints pulls p_up back to 52. impact_sum +0.4 and impact_scaled +0.2 agree in sign. Both are small because nothing unpriced at company level was found.
bar: Q3 consensus is EPS about -$2.16 on revenue about $10.3m, from one preview aggregator (https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/NKTR, as summarised in search on 2026-11-12). That is a single source, so the bar is capped small. The company's own bar is the FY26 guide raised on 2026-08-13: R&D $210-230m and G&A $60-65m (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/pharmaceuticals-biotech/nasdaq-nktr/nektar-therapeutics/news/nektar-therapeutics-nktr-stock-slides-as-cash-burn-clouds-pi, 2026-08-16). Against H1 actuals of R&D $74.8m and G&A $26.2m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/906709/000121390026089137/ea030192901ex99-1.htm), that implies H2 opex of about $170-195m, roughly $85-97m a quarter. Net of about $10m revenue and about $10m interest income, the Q3 loss comes to about $65-75m, or -$1.9 to -$2.2 a share on about 34.5m shares. Consensus sits inside the company's guide. Runway guide: into Q3 2028, past mid-2028 Phase 3 readouts. Cash $1,023.4m at 2026-06-30.
positioning_check: Short interest: about 7.0m shares, 3.5 days to cover on 1.99m average volume, settlement 2026-10-15 (https://massive.com/quote/nktr, page dated 2026-11-10). That is about 20% of 34.14m shares outstanding. At the baseline's 20-day average volume of 622k shares, days to cover is about 11. An earlier page gives 6.97m short and 3.8 days as of 2026-09-30. Crowded short. Skew from the baseline is -15.66 vol points (25d put IV below 25d call IV, so upside is paid) and put/call OI is 0.38. However, the ATM spread is 164% of mid, so the chain is flagged unusable and its magnitude cannot be trusted. Tape: 5-day run-up +4.43%, 20-day +0.08%, -62.4% from the 52-week high, +7.5% off the 52-week low. Insiders: $2.4m of 10b5-1 sales over 12 months and no buys (massive.com, same page).

findings.finding: The FY26 opex guide (R&D $210-230m, G&A $60-65m, raised 2026-08-13) against H1 actuals (R&D $74.8m, G&A $26.2m) implies a Q3 net loss of about $65-75m, or about -$1.9 to -$2.2 a share. The single-source consensus of -$2.16 sits at the pessimistic end of that range, so a small EPS 'beat' is mechanically likely but lands inside the company's guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EPS lines have not moved this name. Q2 2026 (2026-08-13) narrowed the loss year on year and still fell 3.82% as R&D guidance was raised. Q1 2026 fell 1.78%. Median absolute reaction is 3.82% over 7 prints, with 3 up.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The guide is public, and Zacks has published two 'expected to beat' pieces (Oct 29, Nov 5, per massive.com). If the market cared, NKTR would have traded on those notes, and it did not. Filed for completeness and sized near zero.
findings.independence: Guide figures from the Simply Wall St summary of the Q2 call (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/pharmaceuticals-biotech/nasdaq-nktr/nektar-therapeutics/news/nektar-therapeutics-nktr-stock-slides-as-cash-burn-clouds-pi). H1 actuals from the SEC exhibit. Two documents, one arithmetic.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-24 a jury found Lilly breached the implied covenant of the rezpeg license and awarded Nektar $90m plus interest still to be set by the court (8-K item 8.01). Nektar had sought about $1bn, and Lilly says the right amount is zero and will seek reversal. The Q3 10-Q/call may update post-trial status, prejudgment interest or the judgment entry.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The verdict itself barely moved the stock ('Here's Why the Stock Barely Moved', TIKR; GEN: 'Nektar shares flat as $90M jury verdict less than sought').
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock was flat on the verdict, and Canaccord left it out of its model pending appeal. A court-set interest figure or an entered judgment would be new. $90m plus interest is about one quarter of the H2 burn rate, so the only path to value is a marginally longer runway, and it is not recognised as income until collected. Sized as a small one-off.
findings.independence: https://www.tikr.com/blog/a-jury-awarded-nektar-90-million-from-eli-lilly-heres-why-the-stock-barely-moved and https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2026/10/alerts-lifesciences-nektar-v-lilly-defeats-cre-claim-but-owes-90m-for-implied-covenant-breach (independent reporting of the same verdict, one fact)

findings.finding: A crowded short meets a de-rated stock. About 7.0m shares are short (about 20% of 34.14m outstanding, settlement 2026-10-15), about 11 days to cover at the baseline's 622k 20-day volume. The stock is down from $60+ to $37.75 (-62% off the high) after the Oct 1 REZOLVE-AA off-treatment data, where SALT<=20 response slipped from 75% at week 52 to 63% after six months off drug. A print that reaffirms runway into Q3 2028 and the ZENITH timelines removes the near-term financing and timeline fears the shorts lean on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent in the baseline. The last two prints with a similar short base (Q1, Q2 2026) fell 1.8% and 3.8%, but both came with the stock much higher and an R&D guide raise on Q2.
findings.why_not_priced: The short base is public, but the sealed baseline shows call skew of -15.66 and put/call OI of 0.38, so someone is already paying for upside. That suggests part of this is priced. A fully priced squeeze would show as a 5-day run-up well above the +4.4% sealed and a 52-week-low bounce larger than 7.5%. The inference that 'reaffirmation leads to covering' is not a document, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Drop cause: https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9106205/nektar-therapeutics-nktr-shares-drop-after-rezpegaldesleukin-trial-results-on-alopecia-areata (2026-10-01). Analysts called the drop unwarranted (Jefferies $150 PT, https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9106249/jefferies-analyst-defends-nektar-therapeutics-nktr-amid-21-stock-drop-on-rezpegaldesleukin-data). The skew comes from the sealed baseline, a different source, but its chain is flagged unusable.

findings.finding: Runway risk on the guidance line. Three 510-patient ZENITH AD Phase 3s are now running (AD-3 initiated Oct 1), and a single roughly 850-patient ZENITH-AA Phase 3 is planned for early 2027. Against a guide of runway into Q3 2028 from $1,023m, the call could pull the runway in or flag the AA trial cost, which matters with the stock at $37.75 against an April raise priced at $92.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (raised R&D guide to $210-230m) fell 3.82%, the last time this line moved.
findings.why_not_priced: The runway guide was given after the program was sized at three AD trials plus one AA trial, so a cut is not the base case. This is a tail risk, not an expectation, hence the small mean and the wide low end. Financing question: the money buys registrational trials that are already enrolling. Funding a visible ramp makes this a zero-to-small item, not distress.
findings.independence: The ZENITH-AA size of about 850 patients and its early-2027 timing are from https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9106205/nektar-therapeutics-nktr-shares-drop-after-rezpegaldesleukin-trial-results-on-alopecia-areata

findings.finding: As of the registry query on 2026-11-12, ClinicalTrials.gov lists only two rezpeg Phase 3 AD studies (NCT07690371, start 2026-06-29, last update 2026-10-21; NCT07711418, start 2026-08-07), both at 510 estimated. No third (treatment-experienced) ZENITH AD-3 record was found under Nektar's sponsor search, although the company said on Oct 1 that AD-3 was initiated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history: trial-start lags have not been a print line for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody aggregates registry records against press claims. However, registration often lags first-site activation, so this is most likely an administrative gap. A stranger should weight it at near zero unless the call reveals AD-3 has not dosed.
findings.independence: none. The AD-3 initiation claim is from an aggregator summary of the Oct 1 release (https://briefglance.com/companies/nektar-therapeutics/pulses/83580).

findings.why_not_priced: It is public and small. The absence of a post-drop insider buy is a weak signal at most, since plans and blackout explain it.

lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar single-source, finding inside the company's own guide): EPS finding cut 0.3 to 0.1, and print_vs_bar 5.0 to 3.0.
Rule 2 (one-off with no path to the guide): Lilly verdict 0.2 to 0.1.
Rule 5 (positioning is inference, not a document): crowded-short finding 0.8 to 0.6, kept filed.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): runway finding re-read as funding a visible enrolling ramp, -0.3 to -0.2.
Rule 3 (own caveat reaches the number): registry-gap finding -0.2 to -0.1, since my own text says it is probably an administrative lag.
